boot.evidence: 105 boot cycles across 1 instance label(s) (s1); 4 cycle(s) failed to start, 4 cycle(s) never reached the guest's own tick marker. Every run boots with an ephemeral COW overlay, so each cycle starts from the pristine backing image.

no_leftover_processes.evidence: 0 leftover process(es) summed over all cycles, counted by resolving /proc/<pid>/exe (never by pattern: a pattern also matches the calling shell on this device).

images_untouched.evidence: Backing image sha256 AND mtime identical before/after every cycle: yes -- proof the writes went to the COW overlay and the shared image was never modified.

daemon_rss_stable.evidence: Daemon RSS ranged 4608-5468 KB; median of the first 10 cycles 4786.0 KB vs last 10 4758.0 KB (-0.6%). Guest kernel RSS ranged 60964-78892 KB.

docker_every_cycle.evidence: dockerd reached a usable API and a container ran to completion in 101/105 cycles; the guest reports the daemon version and storage driver each cycle.

notes: Direction B (docs/NEXT-STEPS.md). B3 (restart + exposure re-apply) has its own record: evidence/20261030-soak-b3-restart.json.
